engineering_verdict: TPS563201DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) and TPS563208DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) qualify as Level 1 Candidate Drop-In peers: all 6 pins share identical electrical roles, exposed-pad nets match (no EP), and thermal/voltage/temperature-grade margins remain aligned. Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 580 kHz (p.6) vs 580 kHz (p.6) (1x ratio), typical inductor 2.2 µH (p.15) vs 2.2 µH (p.15), feedback Vref 0.768 V (p.6) vs 0.768 V (p.6), and package θJA 92.6 vs 92.6 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS563201DDCR "17 V Max Input (19 V Abs Max) Fails on 24 V Buses Built for Pin-Identical TPS54302DDCR" (p.4) and TPS563208DDCR "FCCM Light-Load Efficiency Collapse (~12% at 5 mA) & 2.9x Higher IQ vs Pin-Identical TPS563201DDCR" (p.9). BOM decision: Choose TPS563201DDCR when light-load battery standby needs 120 µA Iq; choose TPS563208DDCR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOT-23-6 (DDC) qualification and -40..125 °C grade. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
